messages:
sara (AE): Customer BetaCorp wants a sealed-site POC mid-April. On-prem, no egress, strict change window. Need concrete answers on packaging, upgrade cadence, and pricing constraints. Can we support delta updates? :thinking:

mike (SE): Short answer: yes, but with caveats. We can provide a minibundle for initial install + signed deltas for patches. Need clarity on allowed transport (USB vs. jumpbox) and how often they want upgrades. 

olivia (PM): Their SLA asks for quarterly security patches and optional monthly hotfixes. Sales — do they have budget for a support add-on for hotfix cadence? 💸

sara (AE): Budget TBD, execs pushing for minimal ops. They prefer small monthly fees vs large annual. I'll try to get a number by EOD.

raj (InfoSec): Two immediate blockers: 1) KMS/HSM integration — do they require local HSM or can we use customer-managed KMS behind the jumpbox? 2) SBOM and signed artifact verification for every delta.

jen (EngOps): For HSM we support customer-provided PKCS#11 HSMs in Private deployments. If truly air-gapped, we support signing step in CI and verification at install time. We require offline activation token for initial boot.

mike (SE): Example bundle layout we recommend:
```
redwood-mini-v1.2.0.tar.gz
  /sbom.json
  /signature.sig
  /images/
  /patches/delta-1.2.1.sig
```
Installer validates signature and SBOM before unpack.

raj (InfoSec): Also need retention window for logs — they can't send telemetry out. We offer pull-only diagnostic bundles: customer initiates pull to our support infra (via jumpbox) or we provide a CLI to package logs for offline upload.

olivia (PM): Acceptance criteria for POC: 1) successful offline install, 2) security review pass (SBOM/signature), 3) one delta update applied and rolled back, 4) smoke tests pass (<500ms median response on local cluster). Anything to add?

jen (EngOps): Add: documented rollback steps and checksum for each payload. Also specify upgrade freeze windows (we need at least 48-hour window for major upgrades).

sara (AE): Great. Can we get an estimate for bundle engineering + on-call support for 3-month POC? They want fixed price.

mike (SE): Rough estimate: engineering packaging + validation ~ 4 engineering-days, plus a dedicated SE for onboarding (3 days), plus support add-on ~$6k/month if they need on-call during POC. I'll formalize.

raj (InfoSec): Security questionnaire note: we'll provide template answers for HSM, SBOM, signed deltas, and data-in-place policies. I'll draft and ping you, @sara.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #4523 queued: airgap-poc-image-signing-check — status: queued ✅

sara (AE): Thanks. Action items: Mike send formal quote + bill of materials; Raj draft sec q answers; Jen write install + rollback runbook; Olivia confirm acceptance tests. I'll consolidate and update customer.

mike (SE): Will do. ETA for docs & quote: 2 business days.

olivia (PM): I'll block dates for mid-April tentatively. :calendar:

sara (AE): Awesome — keep thread updated. If anyone hits a blocker, call me. :phone:
